verdict.rationale: Dynadot's docs describe several bulk capabilities: the API is pitched for "large bulk adjustments" to accounts and domains, smart folders allow folder-wide changes, bulk search adds every available result to the cart in one click, and bulk transfer moves domains all at once. Together these cover the core of operating on many items at once. missing for 10: evidence that the MCP server supports batch actions for AI-assistant workflows, documentation of specific bulk API endpoints or an OpenAPI spec (probe paths returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk operations at scale.
